name: Hitozuma Hisho no Ura Settai ~ Fukujuu Keiyakusho ni Sign Shita Bijin Tsuma
original_name: 人妻秘書の裏接待～服従契約書にサインした美人妻
source:
Satomi had just signed on as secretary to the executive VP, Keigo Kijima, son of the company president. Meanwhile, her husband who worked at the same company was about to be fired for a trivial mistake. Well well well, thought Kijima to himself, and he made a proposal. Satomi could save her husband's career if she were willing to contract herself as his personal sex slave. She absolutely refused, but there was no choice. 

[From [url=http://www.dlsite.com/ecchi-eng/work/=/product_id/RE065526.html]DLsite English[/url]]
